title: Localization Resource Separation & Stable Text Keys
objective: Separate localizable player-facing text from executable conditions/actions using stable text/resource keys, locale fallback rules, missing-translation diagnostics and deterministic locale projection. Narrative behavior must remain identical across locales except for explicitly localized presentation.
